title: Q-MTC-encryption: encryption of tenant data at rest and in transit, key handling documented
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** every executor run
**Done check:** file:docs/security/tenant-data-encryption.json
**Status:** closed

Multi-tenant control `encryption` is unproven: encryption of tenant data at rest and in transit, key handling documented. Needed: a record, checked by a test, of which tenant tables are encrypted by the application and which rely on the host's encryption at rest; today only credential material is sealed by the application (seed/worker/src/auth/seal.js). The hosted tier stays closed until this is proven. Source: doctrine/tenant-controls.json (TENANT-CONTROLS-1).

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 26.7 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
